title: Linked list
summary: A chain of nodes, each one pointing to the next, like the coaches of a train.

viz.head: head
viz.hello: This list has {n} nodes and head points at {value}. Try add-first, add-last, find or remove.
viz.addedFirst: add-first({value}): the new node points at the old head, then head moves to {value}. Nothing else moved.
viz.addedEmpty: The list was empty, so {value} is now the only node and head points at it.
viz.addedLast: add-last({value}): walked {steps} step(s) to the last node, then linked {value} after it.
viz.found: find({value}): yes, found it at node number {steps}.
viz.notFound: find({value}): no. Checked all {steps} nodes and reached null.
viz.removedHead: remove({value}): it was the head, so head simply moved to the next node.
viz.removed: remove({value}): the node before it now points past it, to {next}.
viz.removeMissing: remove({value}): walked all the way to null without finding it. Error: value not found.
viz.emptyList: The list is empty (head = null). Add a node first.
viz.full: That is enough nodes for this playground ({max}). Remove one first.
viz.resetDone: Started again with an empty list.
